summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of its merger with Hapag-Lloyd AG via a merger subsidiary. The Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated February 16, 2026, was approved at a special meeting on April 30, 2026, and is binding. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026, pending remaining conditions. Terms such as price per share, premium, consideration type, and advisors are not disclosed in this filing. The deal is a cash acquisition going private, with closing subject to regulatory and other approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and any competing bids or antitrust hurdles.
